episodes.title: Domitian
episodes.subtitle: The Last Day
episodes.statusDetail: Four narration sections were completed in the Episode 1 Development conversation. Full scripts have not yet been imported into this repository.
episodes.summary: In the palace on the Palatine, an emperor watches the passing of an hour. Around him are servants, old loyalties and men whose intentions will bring his reign to an end. The story follows Domitian's final day, the memories that shaped his rule, the conspiracy, and the uncertain succession that follows.
context: The Senate, soldiers and the arrival of Nerva
episodes.source: Episode 1 Development conversation and current series-concept document

episodes.title: Nerva
episodes.subtitle: The Emperor Who Chose His Successor
episodes.statusDetail: Sections 1–3 were drafted and were reported as saved in a Google Doc in the Episode Two Outline conversation. Section 4 was not yet written in the last available production note.
episodes.summary: With Domitian dead, Rome has a new emperor but no simple path to security. Nerva faces a wary Senate, an army still loyal to his predecessor, and an increasingly urgent question about who should inherit the empire.
context: Nerva's accession and the aftermath of Domitian
The Senate and the Praetorian Guard
Adoption of Trajan and the imperial succession
episodes.source: Episode Two Outline conversation and current series-concept document

episodes.title: Trajan
episodes.subtitle: A New Emperor at the Frontier
episodes.statusDetail: Trajan is the next subject named in the approved series plan. This is a working proposal, not an approved full script or final title.
episodes.summary: The empire passes to a soldier who begins his rule far from Rome. The story will develop from Trajan's real decisions, relationships and experiences, not a rigid timetable of reigns.
context: Trajan and the succession of AD 98

ideas.title: Pliny the Younger
ideas.description: A potential character-led story drawing on Pliny's writings, senatorial life and his contemporaries. Not assigned an episode number.

ideas.title: The Trial of Marius Priscus
ideas.description: An earlier proposed subject centred on a documented provincial corruption trial. Its eventual narrative placement is undecided.

ideas.title: Beyond Trajan
ideas.description: Further Roman lives and events will be chosen after research rather than fixed to predetermined year blocks.
